prompts.prompt: Create a finished premium brand cover for Choro, a native Mac workspace for people building products with AI. Landscape 2560x1440 YouTube channel banner. Art direction: tactile cinematic 3D sculpture on very dark warm graphite #19181C, luminous frosted lavender glass and softly polished violet ribbons, a few pale ice-blue accents, beautiful soft studio reflections and subtle depth. Three flowing rounded glass lanes join into a poised architectural loop on the right, suggesting coordinated work, elegant and calm, no generic circuitry, no starfield, no robot, no literal code, no app screenshot, no random small widgets. Have a strong memorable spatial silhouette and refined editorial typography. Exact text at center-left: 'Choro' in large clean white sans serif, beneath it 'One place to build your products.' in smaller white sans serif. The artwork and all text MUST concentrate inside the central horizontal strip: x=540 to 2000 and y=535 to 900 in this 2560x1440 canvas; everything outside that strip is only atmospheric graphite background with subtle architectural shadow. Keep at least 70 pixels breathing room within this safe zone. The sculpture occupies the right half of the central safe zone, text left half; no overlap. Full-bleed finished banner with no mockup frame, no annotations, no safe-zone lines, no watermark, no extra logos. The existing avatar is separate; do not invent a new logo symbol.

Premium cinematic 3D sculpture of three softly luminous frosted lavender glass and polished violet ribbons joining into one architectural loop against warm near-black graphite #19181C, a few icy blue highlights, studio reflections, tactile materials, confident quiet editorial design. Place sculpture on far right. Reserve leftmost 22 percent as calm dark atmosphere for profile-avatar overlap. Exact white clean sans serif text in middle section: 'Choro' then 'One place to build your products.' No other text. Strong readable typography, generous horizontal negative space, simple strong silhouette, visually rich rather than thin decorative lines. Keep text and sculpture within central 70 percent of height. No robot, starfield, generic circuitry, busy widgets, literal code, app screenshot, watermark, mockup border, or new logo symbol. Full-bleed artwork. This should feel like an art-directed technology brand campaign, not a stock AI wallpaper.
